how: We read the website of every Pittsburgh wedding florist listed on Lazo (135 listings, 110 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: delivery shops with no wedding page, a bridal dress store, a bakery, a caterer, a produce farm, a bouquet-preservation studio, and a flower cart for retail and corporate events. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is in season locally for my month, and what gets shipped in during a Pittsburgh winter?
Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
Can I see a full wedding's florals, not a bouquet photo, at a budget like mine?

picks.name: Sapphire & Lace
picks.blurb: A Wexford floral and event design company since 2014 that does creative flowers, handmade items and specialty rentals, with a team that calls themselves your flower-loving besties. They also rent an intimate venue by the hour, at $200.

picks.name: Bramble & Blossom
picks.blurb: Pittsburgh's eco-friendly wedding florist: locally sourced flowers, custom designs and ethical practices, with values it lists as sustainable, anti-racist, inclusive and accessible. Options run from full-scale floral installations to blooms for a DIY-friendly wedding.

picks.name: Lilac & Fawn
picks.blurb: Jenny Madia trained through Phipps Conservatory and the PA Floral Academy and is known for sculptural compositions and large-scale installations. Her boutique studio sources flowers locally and from around the world for full-service weddings in Pittsburgh.

picks.name: Allison McGeary Florist
picks.blurb: Custom wedding floral and event design in Pittsburgh built on premium flowers and timeless design. Allison McGeary treats color, texture, lighting and linens as layers of one immersive environment, from sleek and modern to timelessly elegant.

picks.name: Kindred Flower Farm
picks.blurb: A family flower farm in North Strabane Township run by Josh, Summer and Willa Voelker, growing flowers naturally for wedding arrangements and offering wreath and seasonal classes. For couples who want farm-grown, local stems.

picks.name: Blossoms by Jilliann
picks.blurb: Jillian's boutique, intimate floral studio does personal, modern full-service design for weddings and events across the Greater Pittsburgh area, from a love of flowers and art she traces to her grandmother's garden.

picks.name: Gold Dust Floral
picks.blurb: Janessa Walter brings over ten years of wedding and event experience to whimsical, bohemian and nature-inspired designs: unique color palettes and sculptural organic flowers with a modern twist. Gold Dust has a brick-and-mortar shop in Pittsburgh.

picks.name: Sugar Flowers and Leaves Floral Design
tags: full service or a la carte
picks.blurb: A Sewickley studio offering full-service wedding florals and styling as well as a pre-designed collection you can order a la carte, for boutique and garden-style weddings around Pittsburgh. Holiday decorating and event installation too.

picks.name: greenSinner
picks.blurb: greenSinner does things a little differently: a Pittsburgh floral event design studio focused on memorable guest experiences using smart, sustainable practices. The team says it has no fixed style and shows its work in context, real people in real places.

picks.name: Le Jardin Florals & Home Accents
picks.blurb: Gary Pratt has created every arrangement himself since his Greensburg shop opened in June 2000, working one-to-one with each customer. Le Jardin lists event and wedding flowers among its services and holds Best of Westmoreland and WHJB Best Florist titles from 2020 through 2024.

picks.name: And Flowers, llc
picks.blurb: Not a traditional florist but worth knowing: And Flowers runs flower-arranging parties for weddings and showers in Pittsburgh, so the wedding party makes the arrangements together instead of one person stressing over them before the big day.
